meaning:
§ Tabor = "mound"
n pr mont
a mountain in the plain of Esdraelon rising abruptly and insulated except for a narrow ridge on the west connecting it to the hills of Nazareth
2) a town around the summit of Mount Tabor

elsewhere.note: The border reached to Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth Shemesh. Their border ended at the Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.
